ideas.pitch: An automated evaluation platform that converts academic source code and documentation into a structured product-readiness report, identifying technical debt, scaling bottlenecks, and monetization paths.
ideas.title: ProdValid AI: Academic Project to Market-Fit Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the central 'Project to Product' theme of HTF 3.0, solving the exact evaluation criteria judges will use to filter out student prototypes from scalable products.

ideas.pitch: An automated monitoring platform that utilizes open-source satellite imagery and computer vision to track unauthorized industrial expansion and environmental regulation violations for localized incubation.
ideas.title: GeoAudit India: Satellite-Based Industrial Compliance and Land Use Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy technical execution similar to runner-up infrastructure monitoring hacks, presenting a complete B2B SaaS product ready for incubation support.

ideas.pitch: A transparent smart contract escrow platform designed for university incubation centers to disburse funding to student startups based on verified project milestones.
ideas.title: IncubateChain: Milestone-Based Equity & Grant Escrow for Startups
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the incubator-backed prize and incubation value structure of the hackathon, providing a tangible product prototype that Tula's University can immediately utilize.

ideas.pitch: A localized risk assessment platform utilizing graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models to help regional micro-enterprises secure non-dilutive financing.
ideas.title: RiskLens SME: Automated Financial AML & Credit Risk Scoring for Tier-3 Businesses
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs hard financial engineering and interpretable ML pipelines, mirroring award-winning algorithmic risk platforms.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven forecasting and distribution platform that helps Farmer Producer Organizations predict crop yield demand fluctuations and optimize local logistics.
ideas.title: AgriScale AI: Direct-to-Consumer Supply Chain and Demand Forecaster for FPOs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates rigorous mathematical forecasting with rolling backtests, appealing directly to technical judges seeking real-world economic impact.
